problem_restatement.requested_topology: four crypto assets and four non-crypto assets with ten account position slots
problem_restatement.question: Does the post-ETH-event V58 evidence support representing every configured executable route as corrected and live-ready?
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Reconcile exact candidate topology, prospective observer evidence, source-compatible route economics, configured exits, and exact $5,000 stress without pooling incompatible identities.

first_new_eligible_lifecycle.interpretation: The lifecycle is adverse but unresolved. It cannot yet be counted as a win, loss, or completed trade.

exact_configured_stress.interpretation: Deterministic simultaneous-stop sensitivity using frozen marginal p99 friction inputs; not a joint probability, realized-loss ceiling, or profitability forecast.

route_disposition.BTC: retained incumbent routes with low repeatability confidence; technically source-compatible
route_disposition.HYPE: development-promising alignment route with sparse exact forward evidence and fragile short-side robustness
route_disposition.ETH: high historical cadence but adverse exact forward evidence; second exact lifecycle remains open
route_disposition.SOL: short-only candidate with positive development and pseudo-holdout but materially negative validation and negative pooled stress after largest-winner removal
route_disposition.xyz:SP500: source-native fresh15 v3 route with one prior profitable short, no exact long, and a newer short currently censored by stale or missing profit-lock candle evidence
route_disposition.xyz:SPCX: cash-open short candidate with positive development but unresolved archive risk paths and no resolved prospective short
route_disposition.xyz:SNDK: transferred pressure short lacks current-side expectancy; older incompatible long evidence contains two stop losses
route_disposition.xyz:BRENTOIL: transferred pressure route lacks stable current-identity expectancy; older route was negative and source-native oil-shock stress failed

decision.reason: The charter permits an explicitly approved ungated trial, but technical readiness, exact accounting/rollback artifacts, and honest route-level uncertainty must still be resolved before arming. No implicit performance abort is asserted here.

single_highest_value_next_investigation.action: Resolve the frozen ETH lifecycle at its unchanged 60-bps stop or 12-hour maximum hold, then update the route ranking without retuning or opening validation data.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.why: It is the first new eligible V58 route event, has exact source/depth/funding instrumentation, and directly tests the highest-cadence added crypto route under the actual proposed contract.

operational_work_remaining_before_any_cu: freeze the exact human-approved route, side, sizing, leverage, and exit set
generate an accounting epoch bound to that exact profile
write and test the exact transition and rollback contract
regenerate a fresh flat and order-free eight-asset preflight
verify all-eight-asset TUI and post-start acceptance against the exact identity
require explicit live-risk approval for the final frozen profile

confidence.basis: Exact config parsing, immutable observer and stress artifacts, source-bound route journals, and an unresolved prospective ETH lifecycle.

falsifiers: Any recorded evidence hash or byte count changes.
The ETH lifecycle resolves under a different entry, stop, fee, funding, or maximum-hold contract.
A source-compatible route reaches its preregistered evidence threshold and materially updates the route disposition.
A fresh preflight or venue rule invalidates leverage, fee, depth, or sizing assumptions.
The final human-approved profile intentionally differs from the V58 candidate summarized here.
